# Wayfinder reference reconstruction

## 1. Visual contract
The three supplied 1536px-wide slices form one 1536×1024 desktop page. Preserve all visible wording, counts, relative geometry and the selected Overview/Week states. The dark forest sidebar, lime accents, rounded white panels and architectural doorway illustration define the reference. No new visual direction. Energy 2, rhythm 2, motion 0: static initial presentation.

## 2. Tokens
- Canvas #faf9f6; panel #fff; ink #09131c; forest #0b3325; muted #687079; borders #d7dce0.
- Selected lime #d9ff96; ring lime #cbff60; green change #00820b; confirmed #daf6ce; pending #ffcfbf with #ad2c13 text.
- Secondary illustration greens: #e0f8af, #8da985, #41694d. Avatar fills: #d8f6cf, #ffccbe, #bfd9ff; account #d4fbe5.
- Panel and primary control radius 10px; tag radius 6px; status radius 15px; circular avatars.
- Main spacing: left 39px, right 22px, row gaps 20–21px; metric gap 18px; panel padding 24px; sidebar inset 20px.
- Fine line weight 1px; chart stroke 2.5px; icon stroke 1.8px. White panels use barely perceptible white-to-cool-white shading, with no heavy shadows. Forest surfaces have subtle tonal shading matching the reference.

## 3. Typography
Use local Arial/Helvetica sans-serif without remote fonts. Body 16px, small labels 14px; metric labels 16px and values 42px bold; heading 50px/60px bold with -1.3px tracking; subtitle 24px/29px. Section titles 24px/29px bold with -0.6px tracking. Logo 21px uppercase with 4px tracking. Promotional display uses Georgia 40px/42px, tightly tracked. Promo supporting text 18px/26px. Chart ticks and table cells 14px. Utilization value 40px bold.

## 4. Layout
Desktop sidebar occupies x=0–267 and full viewport height. Logo at (29,31), building control at (20,106), nav starts y=178 with 64px pitch. Account divider at y=932 and account row y=956. Main x=306–1514. Breadcrumb at y=31, date/notification/create controls y=19–63. Heading top y=66 and subtitle y=127. Metrics y=180–327 in four equal columns. Activity and utilization y=348–676 in 806px/388px columns with 14px gap. Lower row y=691: table 729px wide, promo 467px wide, gap 13px; panels end near y=964/967. Footer y=983.
Activity plot has horizontal ticks 0,20,40,60; smooth forest line through Mon≈11, Tue≈22, Wed≈34, Thu≈38, Fri≈42, Sat≈29, Sun≈13; pale green area, Friday selected lime dot and anchored dark tooltip. Utilization ring uses round ends with 84% lime and a muted green track.

## 5. Reusable primitives and states
- SVG icons with consistent stroke and no raster assets; purely decorative icons hidden from assistive technology.
- Sidebar buttons: icon and label, dark idle, lime selected, subtle hover, visible keyboard focus; aria-current identifies selection.
- Buttons: forest primary, outlined date/building, flat text links; hover brightness and visible focus. Building and date use native accessible popovers/inputs when activated. Account and notifications expose small informational popovers.
- Panels: shared border/radius/background; metrics share label/value/detail anatomy.
- Period segmented buttons: Week selected initially, aria-pressed, Month changes labels and data.
- Booking rows: semantic table, circular initials and semantic status text.
- Booking form: native modal dialog with labelled name, space, date/time, status; required validation, cancel/save, Escape dismissal, focus return. Submission appends a row and updates footer status.
- Promo: semantic text plus decorative inline SVG doorway, pendant lamp, plant and architectural lines. Explore spaces selects Spaces. View all expands the booking list state.

## 6. Responsive behavior
At widths below 1100px reduce sidebar to 220px and main padding to 24px; metrics stay four columns until 900px. Below 900px sidebar becomes a full-width header with wrapping navigation; content becomes one column with 16px inset; metrics form two columns; chart and utilization stack. At 375px no fixed minimum content widths: main heading wraps, controls wrap, plot scales via viewBox, booking table reflows into labelled member cards, and promo stays readable. Nothing causes horizontal viewport overflow.

## 7. Accessibility and verification
Semantic aside/nav/main/header/section/table/footer. Text remains DOM text, charts have accessible descriptions. Controls have explicit names, focus outlines, and minimum 40px touch targets where feasible. Native dialog supplies focus containment and Escape support. No animation or network access. Verify desktop geometry, 375px overflow, period state, navigation selection and create/cancel/submit keyboard interactions. Browser QA depends on locally available tooling; do not install dependencies or run background servers.

Validation: HTML parsed successfully; identifiers are unique; observations JSON parses; JavaScript syntax check passes; no external or reference-image assets are used. Local browser automation packages and browser executables were unavailable, so rendered browser QA could not be performed. Desktop coordinates and mobile CSS constraints were checked from source.

document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>selectPage(button.dataset.page)));
document.getElementById('explore-spaces').addEventListener('click',()=>{selectPage('Spaces');footer.textContent='Spaces selected · 24 of 28 spaces active';});
document.getElementById('view-all').addEventListener('click',()=>{selectPage('Bookings');document.querySelector('.bookings').classList.add('expanded');footer.textContent=`Showing all ${document.getElementById('booking-rows').rows.length} upcoming bookings`;});
document.getElementById('new-booking').addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.showModal());
document.getElementById('cancel-booking').addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close());
document.querySelector('.close-dialog').addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close());
form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{event.preventDefault();if(!form.reportValidity())return;const data=new FormData(form);const name=String(data.get('member')).trim();if(!name){form.elements.member.setCustomValidity('Enter a member name.');form.elements.member.reportValidity();return;}const date=new Date(String(data.get('date')));const initials=name.split(/\s+/).map(word=>word[0]).slice(0,2).join('').toUpperCase();const row=document.createElement('tr');const member=document.createElement('td');const memberWrap=document.createElement('div');memberWrap.className='member-cell';const avatar=document.createElement('span');avatar.className='avatar';avatar.textContent=initials;const memberName=document.createElement('span');memberName.textContent=name;memberWrap.append(avatar,memberName);member.append(memberWrap);const space=document.createElement('td');space.textContent=String(data.get('space'));const dateCell=document.createElement('td');dateCell.textContent=date.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'})+', '+date.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});const statusCell=document.createElement('td');const status=document.createElement('span');status.className='status'+(data.get('status')==='Pending'?' pending':'');status.textContent=String(data.get('status'));statusCell.append(status);row.append(member,space,dateCell,statusCell);document.getElementById('booking-rows').append(row);dialog.close();form.reset();footer.textContent='Booking added for '+name+' · Last updated just now';});
form.elements.member.addEventListener('input',()=>form.elements.member.setCustomValidity(''));
document.getElementById('overview-date').addEventListener('change',event=>{if(!event.target.value)return;const date=new Date(event.target.value+'T12:00:00');document.getElementById('selected-date').textContent=date.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'});document.getElementById('date-popover').hidePopover();});
const weekPath='M53 174C91 161 128 149 166 139S242 109 280 104S356 95 395 91S472 72 510 77S588 109 625 121S702 151 740 166';
const monthPath='M53 159C91 155 128 139 166 127S242 150 280 133S356 103 395 108S472 60 510 64S588 95 625 85S702 48 740 53';
document.querySelectorAll('[data-period]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{const month=button.dataset.period==='month';document.querySelectorAll('[data-period]').forEach(item=>item.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(item===button)));const path=month?monthPath:weekPath;document.getElementById('line').setAttribute('d',path);document.getElementById('area').setAttribute('d',path+'V207H53Z');const ys=month?[159,127,133,108,64,85,53]:[174,139,104,91,77,121,166];document.querySelectorAll('#points circle').forEach((point,index)=>point.setAttribute('cy',ys[index]));document.querySelectorAll('#x-labels text').forEach((label,index)=>label.textContent=(month?['Oct 1','Oct 5','Oct 9','Oct 13','Oct 17','Oct 21','Oct 25']:['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'])[index]);document.getElementById('chart-tooltip').setAttribute('transform',month?'translate(0,-13)':'translate(0,0)');document.getElementById('tooltip-text').textContent=month?'Oct 17 · 46 bookings':'Fri · 42 bookings';document.getElementById('plot-title').textContent=month?'Monthly booking activity':'Weekly booking activity';document.getElementById('plot-description').textContent=month?'Bookings across October, with 46 bookings on October 17.':'Bookings rise from 11 on Monday to 42 on Friday, then fall to 13 on Sunday.';}));
